justifications.fit: the new helpers follow the module's own idiom (private, docstringed, mechanism-explaining comments) and introduce no version or ticket identifiers - WORKER_RECORD_NAME, _observed_phase, _carries_orientation_write and the ended-without-manifest state word all name what they do.
justifications.goal_fidelity: case 8's remedy was to restore the advance lost in the supervisor or pointer writer, and the landed change compensates in the reader only at reckon/crew/recovery.py:2678 - measured on the real fleet the stored pointer phase is still never advanced (26 of 41 live pointers read phase=starting while their workers run), so the advance is restored on the row every watch/ticker reader consumes, which is what the reported misread was, but a reader of the raw pointer phase still sees the stale label.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path is inside the declared write_paths and the code change stays inside reckon/crew/recovery.py; the docs/plans edit is the node's own plan section where the dispatch contract permits landing evidence, and no file outside the fence is touched.
